top_signals.title: Taiwan Dollar, Won Slump as Chip Stock Selloff Hurts Sentiment
top_signals.summary: The Taiwan dollar and South Korean won led losses among Asian currencies in early trading as an overnight slump in Wall Street semiconductor shares spilled into regional markets, dampening demand for artificial intelligence supply-chain plays.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: North Macedonian police arrest alleged administrator behind OLVX cybercrime market
top_signals.summary: A raid on a home in a North Macedonian village led to the arrest of the suspected administrator of the OLVX market, according to the Balkan country's Interior Ministry along with the FBI.
